Today J dives into the Wizarding World of Harry Potter to discuss one of the most fun questions in the fandom: Who’s worse: Voldemort or Umbridge?  It feels like there should be an obvious answer and yet Umbridge certainly makes a case for herself.

From stripping all happiness and joy from Hogwarts and Harry, stripping freedom after freedom, and rationalizing torture - is Umbridges brand of evil more relatable and scary than the Dark Lord himself?
